annotations.title: Check UI code for AI design patterns

description: Check a snippet of CSS, HTML or JSX against the Slop Patterns library and return every AI design anti-pattern it matches, with the fix for each. Covers the 101 documented patterns that have a mechanical tell. Useful for reviewing generated UI code.

code.description: The CSS, HTML or JSX to check. Paste it whole; partial snippets work but full files are more accurate.

shareStats.description: Optional, defaults to false. If true, contribute an anonymous count of WHICH rule codes fired to the public monthly figures at https://sloppatterns.com/#stats. Never sends your code, your URL, or any identifier.
